rows.title: Desktop premium UI polish
rows.why_it_matters: Unreadable dark-mode controls, clipped text, and awkward dialogs make the app feel unfinished.
rows.next_action: Finish the all-surface color, spacing, labels, close-action, and no-scroll-trap pass across Avalonia.
rows.acceptance_gate: Every ComboBox, TextBox, NumericUpDown, menu, overlay, dialog, and tab is readable in light and dark mode without hover.

rows.title: Linux KDE dark-mode compatibility
rows.why_it_matters: Arch/KDE users saw white-on-white and black-on-black text in basic workflows.
rows.next_action: Audit every themed control under KDE dark mode and lock Chummer-owned surfaces to coherent brushes.
rows.acceptance_gate: CachyOS/KDE screenshots show readable text and backgrounds across launch, account, builder, help, and report issue windows.

rows.title: Character builder core usability
rows.why_it_matters: New users cannot trust the builder if attributes, karma, build method, metatype, and defaults are unclear.
rows.next_action: Specialize SR4/SR5/SR6 builder labels, remove duplicate attribute steppers, show remaining budget, and fix Modify/Add overlays.
rows.acceptance_gate: Mouse-only SR4 BP troll decker and SR5 karma workflows can be completed without unclear labels or disappearing popups.

rows.title: All Add workflows behave like Chummer5A
rows.why_it_matters: Add Quality already slipped; every Add surface needs the same standard.
rows.next_action: Audit Add Quality, Skill, Gear, Ware, Weapon, Armor, Contact, Spell, Critter, and companion workflows with screenshots.
rows.acceptance_gate: Every Add dialog has readable colors, interactive navigation, search/filter, commit/cancel, and Chummer5A parity screenshots.

rows.title: Origin Dossier starts with the story
rows.why_it_matters: The feature should feel like creating a book, not filling an internal options form.
rows.next_action: Default to race and archetype only, collapse advanced steering, generate the story first, then book/PDF/audio/video.
rows.acceptance_gate: A user can start a dossier, read the story first, open the FlipLink-style book, then request audio/video without touching advanced controls.

rows.title: Alice uses Origin Dossier story as build seed
rows.why_it_matters: Alice should reason from the character's story instead of raw combo boxes.
rows.next_action: Feed the approved story into Alice suggestions for new builds and support read-only dossier generation for finished characters.
rows.acceptance_gate: Origin Dossier E2E proves story generation, Alice follow-up, and established-character dossier creation.

rows.title: Alice can build from scratch
rows.why_it_matters: Opening Alice without a character should produce a complete build, not an error.
rows.next_action: Add no-character mode, explicit build button, option explanations, and GM grant constraints.
rows.acceptance_gate: Alice creates a complete character from settings and explains options such as legality, ware, qualities, and GM constraints.

rows.title: Global AI-off mode hides AI features
rows.why_it_matters: Users who do not want AI should not see AI-labeled buttons, companions, critters, or behavior.
rows.next_action: Finish account-linking question, persist preference, hide AI surfaces, and suppress AI as character companion/critter option.
rows.acceptance_gate: With AI disabled, public and desktop flows hide AI entry points and tests prove no AI-only choices are offered.

rows.title: Claim your copy account flow
rows.why_it_matters: Claim your copy is clearer than login via webpage and should not require manual activation.
rows.next_action: Redesign the account linking dialog around claiming the installed copy, with automatic online claim when possible.
rows.acceptance_gate: Installed app can claim the downloaded copy online, shows a premium handoff, and falls back cleanly if the browser step fails.

rows.title: Personalized claim-copy uplink video
rows.why_it_matters: The login handoff should feel premium while using only consented user data.
rows.next_action: Render a short decker host-entry scene that shows available profile data but only extracts the email for linking.
rows.acceptance_gate: Help menu can replay the login video on demand and account linking can show the personalized email render safely.

rows.title: Updater and install-link reliability
rows.why_it_matters: Users need visible, reliable updates without stalled gio handoffs or silent failures.
rows.next_action: Replace Linux gio package handoff with explicit installer path, show update progress, persist structured failure reasons, and relaunch in place.
rows.acceptance_gate: Windows and Linux older builds discover, download, apply, relaunch, and reconcile state without manual package install.

rows.title: Windows installer premium design
rows.why_it_matters: The installer is the first desktop impression and currently has oversized clipped text.
rows.next_action: Redesign installer layout, typography, DPI behavior, progress, and completion states.
rows.acceptance_gate: Windows installer screenshots at 100 percent and 150 percent DPI show no clipping and feel consistent with Chummer.

rows.title: Current Windows shelf installer proof
rows.source: Windows installer gold proof runs 27872347490 and 27872430827
rows.why_it_matters: Fresh installer code now passes visual proof, but the currently published shelf installer is still the older build and cannot complete the proof chain.
rows.next_action: At the next scheduled morning publish, promote the Windows build that contains the modeless completion prompt and rerun the native installer gold proof against the promoted shelf artifact.
rows.acceptance_gate: The promoted Windows installer artifact SHA matches the proof receipt and has progress plus completion screenshots at 100 percent and 150 percent DPI.

rows.title: AUR package for Arch-based Linux
rows.why_it_matters: Arch users should not need to convert Debian packages.
rows.next_action: Add PKGBUILD generation and publish-pipeline support for an AUR package lane.
rows.acceptance_gate: Arch/CachyOS install path is documented and smoke-tested without converting the .deb manually.

rows.title: Daily 08:00 release policy
rows.why_it_matters: Publishing too often burns credits and makes release truth noisy.
rows.next_action: Enforce one morning publish per day unless a build is necessary for a focused test, and build only the needed platform.
rows.acceptance_gate: Publish pipeline and operator notes default to one 08:00 Europe/Vienna release and per-platform builds only when needed.

rows.title: Downloads always show latest Windows and Linux
rows.why_it_matters: The website is the user's source of truth for stable and nightly installers.
rows.next_action: Keep stable/nightly buttons minimal and ensure each Windows/Linux build updates the download shelf automatically.
rows.acceptance_gate: After a build, chummer.run/downloads exposes the newest Windows and Linux installers with no account-first noise.

rows.title: Minimal chummer.run redesign
rows.why_it_matters: The site must look human-designed, quiet, and respectful of attention.
rows.next_action: Remove public AI/provider/proof/check noise, hide Black Ledger until ready, and focus on what Chummer is, downloads, help, and trust.
rows.acceptance_gate: A skeptical visitor can understand Chummer in five seconds and sees no internal process language on first-visit pages.

rows.title: Humanize public and desktop copy
rows.why_it_matters: Generated-sounding copy undermines trust even when the feature works.
rows.next_action: Run the humanizer loop over website, help, installer, desktop dialogs, and Origin Dossier output.
rows.acceptance_gate: Public and primary desktop surfaces avoid AI, provider, proof, audit, and internal workflow wording unless directly useful.

rows.title: Black Ledger hidden until ready
rows.why_it_matters: An unfinished flagship feature should not dominate the public site.
rows.next_action: Move Black Ledger behind a quieter route and finish globe, media, replay, faction, and newsroom E2E before promoting it again.
rows.acceptance_gate: Black Ledger route has polished visuals, video fallback, route follow-through, screenshots, and is not noisy on the homepage.

rows.title: GM cockpit redesign
rows.why_it_matters: The GM surface should feel like a useful table cockpit, not an internal maintenance list.
rows.next_action: Design graphics, table state, active scene, players, clocks, pressure, grants, and next actions around the GM's real workflow.
rows.acceptance_gate: GM cockpit E2E shows session steering, grants, dossier influence, and table actions without maintenance-language rows.

rows.title: Hard Chummer5A parity exit gate
rows.why_it_matters: The desktop client is not gold until it behaves like a serious Chummer successor.
rows.next_action: Require screenshots for every client surface and side-by-side task parity for veteran workflows.
rows.acceptance_gate: Gold gate fails if a primary surface lacks screenshot evidence, task E2E, or acceptable Chummer5A parity.

rows.title: Reproducible gold proof chain
rows.why_it_matters: Gold cannot be claimed while the checked-in verifier, generated artifact, live recrawl, and release truth disagree.
rows.next_action: Update the final janitor to the current proof root, regenerate fresh live evidence, and fail closed on stale or mismatched release data.
rows.acceptance_gate: A clean checkout can run the checked-in gold verifier and produce a current non-stale verdict that matches the live site and repo docs.

rows.title: Rules coverage authority
rows.why_it_matters: Rules explanations and character legality need current, inspectable coverage.
rows.next_action: Materialize current SR4, SR5, SR6 coverage with golden fixtures, explain receipts, and edition separation.
rows.acceptance_gate: Rules readiness requires meaningful coverage for SR4/SR5/SR6 and blocks zero-fact or stale authority claims.

rows.title: Shadowrun data file completeness
rows.why_it_matters: Character creation cannot feel trustworthy when expected skills, qualities, gear, ware, weapons, contacts, and build options are missing or prefilled strangely.
rows.next_action: Inventory SR4/SR5/SR6 data gaps, prioritize character creation essentials, and add fixtures that prove clean new characters start with intentional defaults only.
rows.acceptance_gate: New SR4/SR5/SR6 characters expose expected core data, remaining budgets, and no surprising preselected skills, weapons, contacts, or qualities.

rows.title: Whole-product E2E coverage
rows.why_it_matters: Broad E2E prevents polish regressions such as unreadable dialogs and broken Add workflows.
rows.next_action: Add and harden tests for Origin Dossier, Alice, every horizon/surface, installers, updater, downloads, help, and account linking.
rows.acceptance_gate: Focused E2E suite catches UI readability, workflow, and release-truth regressions before a daily publish.

rows.title: Table Pulse remote reaction loop
rows.why_it_matters: Table Pulse needs to feel like a useful table tool, not an unproven notification demo.
rows.next_action: Build and verify the GM session, opt-in, remote notification, player reaction, adjudication, state update, and receipt loop.
rows.acceptance_gate: E2E proof shows the complete GM-to-player-to-GM loop with opt-out, useful copy, state changes, and no notification noise.

rows.title: Chummer Instant Help with video library
rows.why_it_matters: Users need instant guidance, optional video, and repair actions instead of booking calls.
rows.next_action: Implement intent routing, text answers, pre-rendered VidBoard catalog, diagnostics, escalation, and freshness gates.
rows.acceptance_gate: Help flow answers, shows a relevant approved video, runs a repair/check, and escalates with diagnostics if unresolved.

rows.title: Minimal SEO optimization
rows.why_it_matters: Search optimization should improve discoverability without making the site feel generated, keyword-stuffed, or noisy.
rows.next_action: Run NeuronWriter and ClickRank only after the minimal human copy is accepted, then keep or reject suggestions by attention cost.
rows.acceptance_gate: Optimized public pages remain minimal, human, and clear while search metadata and headings improve without adding visible clutter.

rows.title: Subscribr Tier 7 script lane
rows.why_it_matters: Video pre-production can scale tutorials and release explainers without giving providers product truth.
rows.next_action: Add source packets, channel map, provider verification, script receipts, and human approval boundaries.
rows.acceptance_gate: Subscribr can draft from approved sources only; publication remains disabled until separate human approval.

rows.title: Code quality specialization pass
rows.why_it_matters: Over-generic UI/data paths and hardcoded release or provider assumptions both create brittle product behavior.
rows.next_action: Identify generic surfaces that should become domain-specific and hardcoded assumptions that should become configuration or registry-backed truth.
rows.acceptance_gate: A code-quality pass removes at least one meaningful generic abstraction leak or hardcoded assumption and adds a regression test.

rows.title: Owned LTD inventory and proof paths
rows.why_it_matters: Owned tools such as Dadan, Rybbit, NeuronWriter, Humanizer, VidBoard, and Subscribr need explicit bounded roles.
rows.next_action: Keep LTDs.md and provider receipts current without surfacing provider names on user-facing pages.
rows.acceptance_gate: Inventory lists every owned LTD with role, tier, status, boundaries, and proof path, while public pages stay quiet.

rows.title: Chummer6 design docs current
rows.why_it_matters: Human-facing docs should regenerate from current product design, not stale concepts.
rows.next_action: Update Chummer6 design with Origin Dossier bundle, GM cockpit, Instant Help, Alice behavior, release policy, and provider boundaries.
rows.acceptance_gate: Design source reflects current product decisions before the human-facing docs regeneration runs.

rows.title: Important work Teable sync
rows.why_it_matters: The project needs a concise operating board for everything that actually matters.
rows.next_action: Refresh this projection after material product-scope changes and keep stale or resolved rows honest.
rows.acceptance_gate: Teable contains one current row per critical Chummer workstream and can be refreshed without duplicating records.
